dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals:

Frosty colors have just appeared throughout the countryside,/
Autumn sounds echo unexpectedly through the trees./
The distant mountains cannot be seen,/
As the evening mist spreads, thicker and deeper./

	Casually painted at the bamboo window on the solstice day of the dingyou year [1657]. Zhang Feng. [seal] Feng. [seal, lower left corner] Shangyuan Laoren.

(Translation by LYSL/HK/WKH)
3 additional seals: 1 of Fa Liang (Qing Dynasty); 2 unidentified.
